newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Cold wave kills 33 in Bangladesh.
newsitem.headline: Cold wave kills 33 in Bangladesh.

text.p: A cold wave sweeping northern Bangladesh has killed at least 33 people over the past week, local officials said on Tuesday.

Fourteen people died of exposure in Dinajpur as the temperature dropped to five degrees Celsius (41 Fahrenheit), the officials said. Other casualties were reported from neighbouring districts also facing a relatively severe winter.
Meteorology officials said the lowest temperature recorded last winter was 12 degrees Celsius (53 Fahrenheit).
Dhaka's popular Bangla-language newspaper, Janakantha, put the death toll from the cold wave at 109 in 13 northern districts.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina on Monday ordered immediate distribution of clothes among the poor in the north, government officials said.
